replicaTaking: Its replica is taking its place
replicaFailed: Its replica could not take its place
routerPaused: Paused, wakes on the next connection
follows: Follows it, takes its place if it is lost
jobWaiting: Job {id} ({op}) is waiting to start: {done} of {steps} steps. Writes to a range pause for a moment when it moves.
jobState: Job {id} ({op}) is {state}: {done} of {steps} steps. Writes to a range pause for a moment when it moves.
sentenceRouterDown: The router is not answering, so queries are not reaching the cluster nodes.
sentenceJoining: A node is joining. It starts as a copy of the home node and takes its share of the data once it has joined.
sentenceHomeOnly: Every row is on the home node. Spread a table to put its rows on the cluster nodes.

sentenceServing.one: The router sends each query to the home node or to the node holding its rows.
sentenceServing.other: The router sends each query to the home node or to the {count} nodes holding its rows.
